folders.app/scripts: This folder contains scripts for handling PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 conversions and serving the app registration page.
folders.app/src: Manages GitHub API version, handles requests, schedules tasks, manages session tokens, and configures workflows for GitHub installations.
folders.app/tests: This folder contains test files for various components of the app, including in-memory data structures, mock services, and unit tests for specific features.
folders.scripts: This folder contains scripts for managing Ollama releases and models, including hashing archive files, updating model pinning, and computing checksums.
folders.src: This folder contains various utility and configuration files used throughout the project, including functions for parsing, analyzing, and managing code and comments.
folders.test: This folder contains test files that define and verify various aspects of the project, including action steps, anchors, big layers, check runs, comments, configuration, coverage, documentation, end-to-end tests, edges, excalidraw-like project, first run, Git repository, heavy level, and test helpers.
